opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering arts training for school‑age children under 18
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children outside regular school hours

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Each institution can apply for a maximum total award of £475,000; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions offering undergraduate or postgraduate courses in fine and performing arts
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries for outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate students in the fine and performing arts

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowship to undertake a significant piece of publishable research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who are UK residents and formerly held a teaching or research post at a UK university
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete a research project and prepare results for publication

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers, applying individually or as a consortium
opportunities.summary: Provides up to 30 doctoral scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (including Oxford, Cambridge and Imperial) to establish a research centre
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs; up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university
opportunities.summary: Two‑ to three‑year fellowship to complete a piece of original research

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with international impact, holding a permanent UK university post
opportunities.summary: Prize awarded for any research purpose, funded over 2‑3 years

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers in any discipline, UK‑based, with a UK university post
opportunities.summary: Fellowship of up to 24 months to support research

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK appointment, building a research team
opportunities.summary: Supports research leadership and team development over 4‑5 years

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and eligible research institutes
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative research projects up to five years

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) to host an eminent overseas professor
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of senior overseas scholars to UK institutions for 3‑12 months
